entities.name: Jelena Karleuša
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jelena Karleuša is a Serbian singer and media personality. Born and raised in Belgrade, she began her music career with the release of her debut album Ogledalce (1995) at the age of 16. Karleuša has released twelve studio albums to date and has held two major solo concerts in Belgrade: All About Diva at the Belgrade Arena (2010) and Viva La Diva at Ušće Park (2013).
